name: National Museum of History
nameVi: Bảo tàng Lịch sử Quốc gia
summary: One ticket covers two buildings. Start at the long yellow facade at 1 Trang Tien, south of Hoan Kiem, for Vietnam from prehistory to 1945, then cross to 216 Tran Quang Khai for the mid-19th century to the present. The museum shuts for a long lunch, so go early in the morning or after 13:30.
getThere: 1 Trang Tien, south of the lake
heroCaption: The National Museum of History at Trang Tien

notice.title: Avoid Mondays
notice.body: The museum may be closed on any Monday. Pick another day if you can.

body: The ticket covers two addresses. 1 Trang Tien holds the displays from prehistory to 1945. 216 Tran Quang Khai holds the displays from the mid-19th century to the present. The building at Trang Tien is the yellow facade south of Hoan Kiem, near the Opera House.
The doors close from 12:00 to 13:30, so split the two buildings across the morning and the afternoon, or do one well. A camera and a video camera are extra tickets. Tet has its own opening hours.

figures.caption: The long yellow facade and its tiled roof
figures.alt: The yellow facade of the National Museum of History in Hanoi

gettingThere: 1 Trang Tien is south of Hoan Kiem, near the Opera House. 216 Tran Quang Khai is the second building on the same ticket. Walk from the lake.
closed: Every Monday (vnmh.com.vn, baotanglichsu.vn); first Monday of the month only (baotanglichsuquocgia.vn). Tet hours announced separately.
admissionNote: Adult 40,000 VND. College student 20,000 VND. School pupil 10,000 VND. Under 6 free. The ticket covers 1 Trang Tien and 216 Tran Quang Khai. Camera 30,000 VND. Video 400,000 VND.
